regime.label: Risk-off
regime.detail: Stocks are falling while Treasury yields fall, so money is moving into bonds.
flags: gold is falling too, so even a usual safe haven is being sold

read: The S&P 500 fell 0.5% on Tuesday, Nov 24 and fell 1.9% over the past week. The VIX closed at 26.4.
Over the week, the 10-year yield fell 20 bp to 4.90%, oil fell 4.6%, gold fell 7.8%, the dollar rose 0.7%, and chip stocks fell 7.2%.
Strongest sector this week: Consumer discretionary (+0.5%). Weakest: Semiconductors (−7.2%).
The biggest news themes right now: Inflation, jobs & economy, AI & chips, Trade, tariffs & China.
